build_optimizer: build a PyTorch optimizer from timm or torch.optim with model parameters and config
build_lr_scheduler: build a learning rate scheduler from timm or torch.optim.lr_scheduler for an optimizer
create_scaling_scheduler: create a ScalingScheduler that linearly or cosinely decays a model attribute over epochs
freeze_model_grads: freeze model gradients temporarily using a context manager and restore them afterward
restart_from_checkpoint: restart training from a checkpoint by loading model state dicts and run variables
